verses.1: Oh, those who are thirsty! Go to the water. But since they have no money, they must go without money and without any food. They must go without anything at all.
verses.2: Why do you weigh money when there’s no bread to eat? Why do you travel when there’s no joy in hearing My voice and eating good food? And why do you indulge in pleasures that only bring sorrow to your souls?
verses.3: Hear my words, and come to me. Then your souls will be saved, and I will make a covenant with you forever. This is the covenant of the righteous God.
verses.4: And I am also a witness to the nations. I give them advice and commands for them.
verses.5: May those nations not know your name, and may they not desire to approach you. May they do so only for the sake of Jehovah, your God, and for the sake of Israel’s holiness. For you are truly magnificent.
verses.6: The LORD demanded that he be found; they called out to him when he was in need.
verses.7: The wicked will leave their wrong ways, and those who are full of evil thoughts will be turned back to God. Then He will have mercy on them and bring them back to our Lord, so that they may be saved.
verses.8: For my thoughts are not like your thoughts, and your ways are not like mine. As the LORD says.
verses.9: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so too are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts higher than your thoughts.
verses.10: For when the snow and frost descend from the heavens, and the sun no longer rises again, then the earth will be restored to life. It will grow and produce seeds for others to plant, and bread for people to eat.
verses.11: So, whatever I say will not return to me as an error. For I have done what I desired, and I have succeeded in what I sent out.
verses.12: For in joy you will go forth, and in peace you will return. The mountains and valleys will open up before you, filled with joy. And all the trees in the fields will bear fruit.
verses.13: Under the nail, a branch will grow; under the scabbard, a thorn will grow. And it will become a sign for God, a reminder of eternity, so that no one will ever forget it.
